Wonne.et: From Middle High German wunne, wünne, from Old High German wunna, from Proto-West Germanic *wunnju (“joy”), from Proto-Germanic *wunjō (“joy”). More at winne.

s: May (fifth month of the Gregorian calendar)
Im Wonnemonde schlagen die Bäume aus.
Du hast mir gebracht, wonach ich gefragt habe.
You brought me what I asked for.
cute, cheerful baby or small child; bundle of joy
"where nothing is left, even the ruler has lost his powers"; only talent and beauty have real value
